info.name: Pirate Store - Error Tests
info.description: Tests for error scenarios: Invalid/Missing Token, Invalid ID, Invalid Email, Duplicate User, Unauthorized Access, Validation Errors.

exec: pm.test('201 or user exists', function(){ pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200,201,400]); });
try {
var body = pm.response.json();
if (body.token) pm.environment.set('userToken', body.token);
if (body._id) pm.environment.set('userId', body._id);
} catch (e) {}
pm.test('Expect duplicate user error (400)', function(){ pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(400); });
try { var b = pm.response.json(); pm.test('message includes duplicate or exists', function(){ pm.expect(b.message.toLowerCase()).to.include('exist'); }); } catch(e) {}
pm.test('Expect invalid email (400)', function(){ pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(400); });
try { var b = pm.response.json(); pm.test('message mentions email', function(){ pm.expect(b.message.toLowerCase()).to.include('email'); }); } catch(e) {}
pm.test('Expect invalid token -> 401', function(){ pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(401); });
try { var b = pm.response.json(); pm.test('message is Invalid token', function(){ pm.expect(b.message).to.eql('Invalid token'); }); } catch(e) {}
pm.test('Expect missing token -> 401', function(){ pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(401); });
try { var b = pm.response.json(); pm.test('message mentions token', function(){ pm.expect(b.message.toLowerCase()).to.include('token'); }); } catch(e) {}
pm.test('Expect invalid id -> 400', function(){ pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(400); });
try { var b = pm.response.json(); pm.test('message mentions invalid id', function(){ pm.expect(b.message.toLowerCase()).to.include('invalid'); }); } catch(e) {}
pm.test('Expect forbidden (403) for non-admin', function(){ pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(403); });
try { var b = pm.response.json(); pm.test('message mentions admin', function(){ pm.expect(b.message.toLowerCase()).to.include('admin'); }); } catch(e) {}
